t: The Brackenheath iSpot G3 Frameless is a high-performance 20W LED floodlight designed to deliver bright 2200lm cool white illumination. Suitable for residential applications, this durable unit is ideal for illuminating driveways, gardens and building perimeters. It features a robust die-cast aluminium body and tempered glass diffuser, offering an IP65 rating for reliable weather protection. The rewireable design with push-fit terminals includes an easy-install hook bracket for quick pre-wiring, plus loop-in and loop-out cable glands for linking multiple iSpot G3 floodlights up to 300W.
b: Series-Linkable System Connects Multiple Lights up to 300W
Rewirable Connection Simplifies Quick Retrofitting Tasks
Easy-Install Hook Bracket Enables Fast Mounting
